rejected_iq.phase_scope: Unreferenced phase of retained rejected IQ only; no coherent reference, no phase reconstructed from PSD

findings: Headroom rejection: conservative threshold exceeded by rare IQ peaks; retained evidence does not demonstrate digital rail clipping. Pilot-only gain qualification now reserves 12 dB by default; live rejection triggers bounded gain backoff into a new partition.

USB abort: host idle sleep/wake coincided with device loss. The supervisor holds scan-scoped sleep assertions, recognizes specific transport failures, bounds reopen retries and detects stalled output. Unknown crashes remain fatal.
Duration: setup, outage gaps above five seconds, and inter-attempt downtime do not consume the acquisition budget. Every attempt and accepted partition is retained with hashes.
limits: Antenna measurements cannot establish absolute power, noise figure, analog compression or calibrated sensitivity.
PSD Doppler matches and off-curve controls do not establish decoded identity or a calibrated global false-discovery probability.
PSD contains no recoverable waveform phase. Phase diagnostics are limited to retained rejected IQ without a coherent RF reference.
Sequential LO comparisons are conditional on the changing RF environment and receiver state. No candidate-origin label automatically removes data.
The configured 12 dB burst reserve and five-second gap policy are engineering choices, not universal statistical guarantees.
